what_would_change.label: Risk-on
what_would_change.text: Risk-on: risk-off ratios at weekly 3/5 or better now 0 of 6 scored. Risk-on at 0–1, Cautious at 2–3, Risk-off at 4 or more.

what_would_change.label: Growth-led
what_would_change.text: Growth-led: 13 of 17 at weekly 5/5 (Growth-led needs 9). Leadership mixed at 8 or fewer.

what_would_change.label: Narrow breadth
what_would_change.text: Narrow breadth: RSP/SPY weekly 0/5. Narrow breadth at 1/5 or less, Breadth neutral at 2/5–3/5, Broad breadth at 4/5 or more.

what_would_change.label: Credit strong
what_would_change.text: Credit strong: JNK/IEF weekly 5/5. Credit weak at 1/5 or less, Credit neutral at 2/5–3/5, Credit strong at 4/5 or more.

what_would_change.label: Yields rising
what_would_change.text: Rates: US10Y weekly 5/5 (in the headline as "Yields rising"). 4/5 or more adds "Yields rising", 1/5 or less adds "Yields falling", 2/5–3/5 adds nothing.

2 FEAR GAUGES - CREDIT & DEFENSIVE.direction: Aligned down = risk-on; JNK/IEF not inverted (Aligned up = risk-on)

changes.method: prior week re-scored from this run's data cut at the prior Friday close

section_keys.1 REGIME - INDICES & RATES: Indices & rates — high score = the index or yield itself is trending up (VIX high = volatility rising; US10Y high = the 10-year yield rising; IEF/IEI high = Treasury prices rising, i.e. yields falling).
section_keys.2 FEAR GAUGES - CREDIT & DEFENSIVE: Fear gauges — ratios: high score = the defensive numerator (cash, Treasuries, staples, low-vol, yen, commodities) leading stocks; credit ETFs on their own (JNK, BKLN, LQD, BSV): high score = those bond prices rising. Exception JNK/IEF: high = high-yield leading Treasuries (credit spreads tightening).
section_keys.3 GROWTH LEADERSHIP: Growth leadership — high score = the growth/tech numerator leading the broad market or value.
section_keys.4 BREADTH & ROTATION: Breadth & rotation — high score = equal-weight, small caps, cyclicals, value or dividend stocks leading cap-weight SPY or tech (broadening); XLF on its own: high score = financials trending up.
section_keys.5 FOREIGN: Foreign — high score = the foreign market leading the US (SPY or XLK); exception XLK/SPDW, where high score = US tech leading developed ex-US.
section_keys.6 REAL ASSETS: Real assets — high score = the commodity or miner trending up, or leading stocks; Copper/Gold and Crude/Gold high = the industrial commodity leading gold.
